bio.text: Emanuel Cleaver II is serving his eleventh term representing Missouri's 5th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and is a member of the House Committee on Financial Services.
Before Congress he served twelve years on the Kansas City Council and was elected the city's first African American mayor in 1991, serving eight years.
He holds a bachelor's degree from Prairie View A&M and a master's from St. Paul's School of Theology of Kansas City; he is a native of Waxahachie, Texas, and lives in Kansas City.
